text:
ana: Quick check-in from me — audits and IAM/KMS focus today.
What I did: started the KMS key rotation plan for prod keys, ran the IAM policy diff for service accounts, and triaged the SCA findings from the nightly scan.
Blockers: can't access HSM audit logs (need infra ticket / HSM team permission). Also hitting a permissions error for the deployer SA when trying to update kms:Encrypt.
Today: finish rotation playbook, open PR for least-privilege role change, and gather encryption config artifact for compliance.

security-bot: nightly-sca scan completed. 7 findings in infra-managed libs (non-critical). See report: https://ci.internal/reports/1768923-sca-report.pdf

matt: thanks ana. can you paste the exact error for the deployer SA? I can prep a quick IAM change if it's just missing kms:Encrypt.

ana: error is: 
```
AccessDenied: User: service-account-deployer@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com does not have permission to perform kms.encrypt on projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/prod-kr/cryptoKeys/prod-key
```
I proposed role `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on the key resource in the PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/commit/ff12ab3

leo: I'll check audit logs once infra grants HSM log access. noticed a gap: no rotation event recorded for staging-key last month — filing a ticket: INC-6543 and assigning to infra.

jess: FYI I pushed a small fix for the dependency flagged by SCA (patched to 3.2.1). PR: https://git.internal/redwood/security/pull/432 — reviewers: @matt, @ana. Quick review would be great, it's low-risk. :thumbsup:

sam: compliance request — they want an artifact showing KMS is enabled and CMK ARNs for the last 12 months for SOC2. I can assemble but need the list of key versions and policy snapshots. Ana, can you include that in the rotation playbook?

ana: yes, I'll add a `key_evidence/` folder in the rotation playbook with: key list, version history, rotation timestamps, policy snapshots, and HSM attestation (once we get logs).

matt: if you want, I can escalate HSM access with infra. @infra-bot can you create a support request to the HSM team and cc security?

infra-bot: Support ticket created: INFRA-2987 — Subject: HSM audit log access for eng-security. Assigned to infra-oncall. Link: https://tracker.internal/INFRA-2987 (reacted :eyes:)

ana: awesome, thanks. That should unblock the evidence for compliance.

leo: once HSM logs are available I'll correlate rotation events with key versions. Should have a quick report by EOD.

jess: reviewed and merged my patch, PR closed. :tada:

matt: pinged on the IAM PR and added a small note about scoping the role to the key ring rather than the whole project.

ana: noted — will update the PR to scope to the key ring. Thanks everyone, I'll post an updated playbook link when done.

sam: no other blockers from compliance side. thanks!

ana: closing loop — follow-ups: INFRA-2987 (HSM logs), INC-6543 (staging rotation gap), PRs: infra/ff12ab3 (IAM role), security/432 (dependency).
